_readme: THE MERRIMACK FROM THE WATER COMPOSITES (docs/FIDELITY.md): the shipped scene with its water read from one
product per layer instead of the place's own files -- the bed's tiers (CUDEM 1/9 and 1/3 arc-second, ETOPO 15 and 60 arc-second
under them), every tide station and model point, every current station and model field, every forecast
point and buoy the fidelity map paints. Make the products first (network once, cached after):
dotnet run --project harvest/harvest -- compose-water --fidelity harvest/testdata/coast3_3to10m.gafid --out data/composite/coast3
The river stays the place's own gauges (data.river): the composite's river holds the gauges INSIDE the painted
regions, and the solver's discharge is measured upstream of them.
